items.title: Detecting a property of the fibres on localisations
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a homomorphism of Noetherian rings, a property P of the fibres that can be checked on local rings may be tested after localising at any prime or even only at maximal ideals, and the proof is an 18-line argument built on the identification of the fibre over a prime with the localisation of the target. It relates the fibre over a prime to the fibre over a maximal ideal containing it by a base change computation, and then invokes the hypothesis that P is a local property of rings to pass between the localisations. The base change computation is the substance, and it is displayed explicitly.
